scope: Independent direct-array recomputation of all frozen selections, all comparator point estimates and conditional intervals; no model/forward/update; no change to original registered script or receipt.
F_fixed_training_labels: A-to-B uses F true A derivatives; B-to-A uses F true B derivatives; score same chosen domain in evaluation bank
predictor_target_structure: Original ridge has eight separable output columns, [A four domains, B four domains]. Each policy chooses only within one four-domain bank, or no_update plus that bank.
marginal_scope: Global R selector frequencies; not per receiving domain; recomputed globally in every category-stratified record bootstrap draw. Conditional on this vector, randomized comparator action is independent of event/domain/category/target.
inference_boundary: Conditional on fixed source A/B, fitted predictors and the previously exposed R panel. Not independent confirmation, source-population uncertainty, or new-model generalization.
